name: The Coffin of Andy and Leyley
source:
Cannibalism and codependency!

Caught in an extremely toxic sibling relationship, a brother and sister must survive starvation, as well as each other.
One day, they start practicing cannibalism after witnessing a botched satanic ritual.

How will you escape death and the consequences of your actions?

[Edited from Itch.io and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2378900/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
自相残杀和相互依赖！

陷入极度有毒的兄弟姐妹关系中，兄弟姐妹必须在饥饿中生存，彼此也必须生存。
有一天，他们在目睹了一场拙劣的撒旦仪式后开始练习同类相食。

你将如何逃脱死亡和你行为的后果？

[编辑自Itch.io和 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2378900/]Steam[/url]]
